author: Praxis I
title: BRBG-Dual-bestcfg: ComBat PCA64 Embedding + Residualized-PC Balanced Graph (γ=0.74, k=48)
abstract: Re-run of our best dual-output configuration for verification and reproducibility via storage modules: ComBat-corrected PCA (64 PCs) for X_emb and a batch-residualized PC graph (γ=0.74, l2=1e-3) with equal-quota balanced cosine kNN (k=48, binary).

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from praxis.brbg_dual_comb_resid_graph import dual_output_brbg
import anndata as ad

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    # Best-known configuration (expected ≈ EID 147)
    return dual_output_brbg(adata, n_pcs_emb=64, n_pcs_graph=50, gamma=0.74, l2=1e-3, k_total=48, metric='cosine')
